title: Modern Baseball Player Stats Dashboard
description: A responsive dashboard displaying baseball player statistics including batting average, home runs, RBIs, and recent game performance. Composed of a player profile card, stats table, and performance chart components.

components.name: StatBadge
components.description: A small pill-shaped badge displaying a single stat label and its value. Used inside stat cards and tables.

value.description: The numeric value of the statistic

trend.description: Optional trend indicator to show improvement or decline

layout.tailwind: inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Circular player avatar image with a fallback to player initials when no image is available.

alt.description: Alt text for the image, typically the player's full name

initials.description: 2-letter fallback initials when src is unavailable

size.description: Controls the diameter of the avatar

layout.tailwind: relative flex items-center justify-center rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 shrink-0

components.name: SectionHeading
components.description: A styled section title with an optional subtitle, used to label dashboard sections.

components.name: StatCard
components.description: A card displaying a single key statistic with its label, value, optional trend arrow, and a sparkline or contextual note. Used in the quick-stats strip.

trend.description: Direction of trend vs previous period

trendValue.description: Delta text shown next to the trend icon (e.g. '+0.012')

icon.description: Name of icon to display at the top of the card

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-2 p-5 rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-md border border-gray-100 min-w-[140px]

components.name: PlayerProfileCard
components.description: Displays the player's avatar, full name, team, position, jersey number, and a row of key StatBadges. Acts as the hero section of the dashboard.

teamName.description: Name of the player's current team

teamLogoUrl.description: URL for the team logo image

nationality.description: Player's nationality or country flag code

keyStats.type: Array<{ label: string; value: string | number; trend?: 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral' }>
keyStats.description: Top 3–4 statistics to highlight in the profile card

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center md:items-start gap-6 p-6 md:p-8 rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 to-blue-900 text-white shadow-xl

components.name: StatsTableRow
components.description: A single row inside the stats table, representing one game entry or category row. Highlights top or recent rows.

isHighlighted.description: Whether to visually emphasize this row (e.g. best game)

layout.tailwind: grid grid-cols-7 gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-sm border-b border-gray-100 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors duration-150

components.name: StatsTable
components.description: A sortable, paginated table listing per-game or per-season player statistics. Includes a header row, body rows, and a footer with pagination controls.

rows.description: Array of game stat row data objects

isLoading.description: Shows skeleton rows while data loads

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-0 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-white shadow-md border border-gray-100

components.name: PerformanceChartTooltip
components.description: Custom tooltip shown when hovering a data point on the performance chart. Displays date, stat value, and opponent.

value.description: Y-axis stat value at the hovered point

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs shadow-xl pointer-events-none

components.name: ChartLegend
components.description: A legend row listing the metrics plotted on the performance chart with their color indicators.

items.description: Legend entries with label and Tailwind/hex color

layout.tailwind: flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-sm text-gray-600

components.name: PerformanceChart
components.description: A multi-line or bar chart visualizing the player's performance trends over recent games. Supports toggling between batting average, home runs, and RBIs. Includes axis labels, grid lines, legend, and a hover tooltip.

data.type: Array<{ date: string; battingAverage: number; homeRuns: number; rbis: number; opponent?: string }>
data.description: Ordered array of per-game data points for the chart

activeMetrics.description: Which metrics are currently toggled on in the chart

isLoading.description: Renders a skeleton placeholder while chart data loads

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-4 p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-md border border-gray-100

accessibility.ariaLabel: Performance trend chart for selected metrics over recent games

components.name: QuickStatsStrip
components.description: A horizontally scrollable strip of StatCards showing the four primary statistics: Batting Average, Home Runs, RBIs, and Hits. Sits between the PlayerProfileCard and the detailed sections.

gamesPlayed.description: Number of games played this season

isLoading.description: Shows skeleton placeholders for each card

layout.tailwind: flex flex-row gap-4 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide

components.name: DashboardFilterBar
components.description: A toolbar allowing the user to filter dashboard data by season year and select which metrics to display on the performance chart.

availableSeasons.description: List of season years to choose from

activeMetrics.description: Metrics currently active in the performance chart

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3

components.name: PlayerStatsDashboard
components.description: The full-page layout template that assembles the PlayerProfileCard, QuickStatsStrip, DashboardFilterBar, PerformanceChart, and StatsTable into a cohesive responsive dashboard.

playerId.description: ID of the player whose stats are displayed

sections.name: Header
sections.tailwind: sticky top-0 z-10 bg-white border-b border-gray-200 shadow-sm px-4 md:px-8 py-3 flex items-center justify-between

sections.name: MainContent
sections.tailwind: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 py-6 flex flex-col gap-6

components.name: PlayerStatsDashboardPage
components.description: The routable page component that renders the PlayerStatsDashboard template, handles route params (playerId), and manages top-level data-fetching state.

params.description: Route parameters injected by the router

breakpoints.mobile: < 640px — single column, horizontally scrollable stats strip
breakpoints.tablet: 640px–1024px — two-column layout for chart and table side-by-side optional
breakpoints.desktop: ≥ 1024px — full multi-column dashboard with sticky header

interactions.action: Row background transitions to blue-50 to indicate focus
Sorts table rows ascending by that column; second click reverses to descending; active column header shows sort arrow icon
Toggles the corresponding metric line on or off in the PerformanceChart and updates the chart legend
Fetches and re-renders all dashboard data for the selected season year
Displays the PerformanceChartTooltip showing date, opponent, and stat value at that point
Navigates to the selected page of game rows; active page button is visually highlighted
Horizontally scrolls the strip to reveal additional StatCards that overflow the viewport
Layout reflows responsively: single column on mobile, expanded multi-column grid on desktop
Shows skeleton loading states in all major sections (profile card, stat cards, chart, table) until data resolves
